'''Gold''' is a '''Metals''' commodity carried as ordinary cargo, valued for its corrosion resistance and its use in jewellery, luxury goods, and electronics contacts.<ref name="inara-gold">[https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/42/ Gold — Commodity], Inara.</ref> It is produced by '''Extraction''' and '''Refinery''' economy stations and consumed by most other station types.<ref name="inara-gold" />

== Why it matters for Engineering ==

[[Lei Cheung]] requires '''200 units of Gold''' to unlock his Engineering workshop at [[Trader's Rest]] in [[Laksak]]. As an ordinary commodity, each unit occupies one tonne of cargo space; the full 200-unit requirement needs 200 tonnes of cargo capacity if delivered in a single trip, or can be split across multiple trips.

== Acquisition ==

Gold can be obtained two ways:

* '''Buy it.''' Commodity markets at stations with an '''Extraction''' or '''Refinery''' economy routinely stock Gold.<ref name="inara-gold" /> Use a current commodity-market search rather than assuming one specific station's stock is permanent.
* '''Mine it.''' Gold is a minable metal; prospecting and refining it yourself avoids depending on any station's market stock entirely, at the cost of needing mining equipment and time.

{{Tip|Because 200 units is a substantial market purchase, check current sell/buy prices and available stock at more than one Extraction/Refinery station before committing to a single trip — allocations and prices vary by station and over time.}}
